title: console marketplace: facet filters (business function, industry, solution type) and a Beta badge replace the single category chip row — reads the spec taxonomy (objectstack#30904)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2
Blocked-by: objectstack#30904

Filing gate: **④ coordination child** of objectstack#30904. It is the console `ui/` part of the maintainer's taxonomy ruling (ruling §6, recorded on #30904: 「关掉，Beta 并入分类方案」 and the three taxonomy decisions, all recommended). The ruling says the console part is filed as its own objectstack card. The readings below are the #30904 dev's (PR #30980, report 6690814417).

## 维护者速读

市场页现在只有一排「分类」小标签，用的是即将退役的旧分类。新方案按职能、行业、解决方案类型三个维度筛选，再加一个 Beta 徽标。这张卡把控制台的市场页和详情页改成按这三个维度筛选、显示 Beta，多语言词条也从规格里的枚举生成，不再另抄一份。

## Readings (objectstack, at the #30904 dev's base)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/MarketplacePage.tsx`:
  - category state :363; chips built from `it.category` :555; client filter :571; render :710-722;
  - card badge `pkg.category` :965;
  - raw-value fallback :560-566;
  - `listMarketplacePackages({ limit: 100 })` filters on the client :407.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`: `categoryLabel` :1425-1426, badge :1542.
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/marketplace/*.ts` (9 locales): the `category` block (en.ts :223) copies the retired spec enum.

## Expected

1. Replace the category chip row with facet filters:
   - `businessFunctions`: multi-select, OR within the facet;
   - `industries`: hidden while no loaded listing carries one;
   - `solutionType`: a tab or segment.

   Facets combine with AND, with a count per value.
2. Card badge: the primary business function (`businessFunctions[0]`), plus a Beta badge when `maturity === 'beta'`. The detail page shows every business function, the industries, the solution type and the Beta badge.
3. i18n:
   - delete `marketplace.category.*`;
   - add `marketplace.businessFunction.*` (11), `marketplace.industry.*` (10), `marketplace.solutionType.*` (3) and `marketplace.maturity.beta`, keyed by iterating the spec schemas' `.options` from `@objectstack/spec/marketplace`;
   - a parity test, so no second list exists.
4. Data: the cloud catalog rows' snake_case `business_functions` / `industries` / `solution_type` / `maturity`, once objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 lands. Until then every facet hides; drop the raw-value fallback.
5. Server-side filtering and pagination (ruling §6 ui item 4): facets across hundreds of templates cannot filter 100 rows on the client. Do it in this card or name a sibling.

## Acceptance

- Tests: the filters combine as stated; Beta shows only for `beta`; facets hide with no data; the i18n parity test fails when a spec value has no label.

Serial: after objectstack#30904 (PR #30980) merges. Pairs with objectstack-ai/cloud#3661 for data.

Suggested-grade: p2 (inherits the taxonomy cards).
